name: add_k8s_security_context_hardening
description: Hardens a Deployment's container securityContext: read-only rootfs, no privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped, non-root
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml defines the 'api' Deployment with no securityContext at all, so the container runs as root with a writable root filesystem, full Linux capabilities, and can escalate privileges. Add a securityContext to the 'api' container (or the pod, for runAsNonRoot) setting: readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, runAsNonRoot: true, and capabilities.drop containing "ALL". Keep the replicas, image, ports, and existing labels/selectors unchanged.

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: myorg/api:2.0.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080

test_setup_files.test_secctx.py:
import yaml

with open('k8s/deployment.yaml') as f:
    d = yaml.safe_load(f)

pod_spec = d['spec']['template']['spec']
containers = pod_spec['containers']
assert len(containers) == 1
c = containers[0]

c_sc = c.get('securityContext') or {}
pod_sc = pod_spec.get('securityContext') or {}

assert c_sc.get('readOnlyRootFilesystem') is True, 'container securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem must be true'
assert c_sc.get('allowPrivilegeEscalation') is False, 'container securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation must be false'

run_as_non_root = c_sc.get('runAsNonRoot')
if run_as_non_root is None:
    run_as_non_root = pod_sc.get('runAsNonRoot')
assert run_as_non_root is True, 'runAsNonRoot: true must be set (container or pod level)'

caps = c_sc.get('capabilities') or {}
drop = caps.get('drop') or []
assert 'ALL' in drop, f'capabilities.drop must include ALL, got {drop!r}'

# preserved
assert d['spec']['replicas'] == 2, 'replicas changed'
assert c['image'] == 'myorg/api:2.0.0', 'image changed'
ports = [p.get('containerPort') for p in c.get('ports', [])]
assert 8080 in ports, 'containerPort changed'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: myorg/api:2.0.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            runAsNonRoot: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
